title: chance~

messages.description: impulses to pass to one of the outlets
updates the probabilities when created with more than one
chance in % of an impulse going left, with one or no argument

methods.description: a float sets seed, no float sets a unique internal

body: When [chance~] receives an impulse, it outputs it to an outlet according to its chance (probability weight). The total number of chances is the sum of all arguments.
